options.name: addusernameinrdpfile
options.description: Add username in rdp file.

options.name: api_path
options.description: Base NITRO API path. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: audiocapturemode
options.description: This setting corresponds to the selections in the Remote audio area on the Local Resources tab under Options in RDC.

options.name: keyboardhook
options.description: This setting corresponds to the selection in the Keyboard drop-down list on the Local Resources tab under Options in RDC.

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_id
options.description: The ID of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_ip
options.description: The IP of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_name
options.description: The name of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_password
options.description: The password of the managed NetScaler instance. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call In Settings > Administration > System Configurations > Basic Settings, if you select Prompt Credentials for Instance Login, ensure to configure username and password of a managed instance.

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_username
options.description: The username of the managed NetScaler instance. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call In Settings > Administration > System Configurations > Basic Settings, if you select Prompt Credentials for Instance Login, ensure to configure username and password of a managed instance.

options.name: multimonitorsupport
options.description: Enable/Disable Multiple Monitor Support for Remote Desktop Connection (RDC).

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the rdp profile

options.name: netscaler_console_as_proxy_server
options.description: The IP address of the NetScaler ADC appliance acting as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: nitro_auth_token
options.description: The authentication token provided by a login operation.

options.name: nitro_pass
options.description: The password with which to authenticate to the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: nitro_protocol
options.description: Which protocol to use when accessing the nitro API objects.

options.name: nitro_user
options.description: The username with which to authenticate to the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: nsip
options.description: The ip address of the NetScaler ADC appliance where the nitro API calls will be made. The port can be specified with the colon (:). E.g. 192.168.1.1:555.

options.name: psk
options.description: Pre shared key value

options.name: randomizerdpfilename
options.description: Will generate unique filename everytime rdp file is downloaded by appending output of time() function in the format <rdpfileName>_<time>.rdp. This tries to avoid the pop-up for replacement of existing rdp file during each rdp connection launch, hence providing better end-user experience.

options.name: rdpcookievalidity
options.description: RDP cookie validity period. RDP cookie validity time is applicable for new connection and also for any re-connection that might happen, mostly due to network disruption or during fail-over.

options.name: rdpcustomparams
options.description: Option for RDP custom parameters settings (if any). Custom params needs to be separated by '&'

options.name: rdpfilename
options.description: RDP file name to be sent to End User

options.name: rdphost
options.description: Fully-qualified domain name (FQDN) of the RDP Listener.

options.name: rdplinkattribute
options.description: Citrix Gateway allows the configuration of rdpLinkAttribute parameter which can be used to fetch a list of RDP servers(IP/FQDN) that a user can access, from an Authentication server attribute(Example: LDAP, SAML). Based on the list received, the RDP links will be generated and displayed to the user.             Note: The Attribute mentioned in the rdpLinkAttribute should be fetched through corresponding authentication method.

options.name: rdplistener
options.description: IP address (or) Fully-qualified domain name(FQDN) of the RDP Listener with the port in the format IP:Port (or) FQDN:Port

options.name: rdpurloverride
options.description: This setting determines whether the RDP parameters supplied in the vpn url override those specified in the RDP profile.

options.name: rdpvalidateclientip
options.description: This setting determines whether RDC launch is initiated by the valid client IP

options.name: redirectclipboard
options.description: This setting corresponds to the Clipboard check box on the Local Resources tab under Options in RDC.

options.name: redirectcomports
options.description: This setting corresponds to the selections for comports under More on the Local Resources tab under Options in RDC.

options.name: redirectdrives
options.description: This setting corresponds to the selections for Drives under More on the Local Resources tab under Options in RDC.

options.name: redirectpnpdevices
options.description: This setting corresponds to the selections for pnpdevices under More on the Local Resources tab under Options in RDC.

options.name: redirectprinters
options.description: This setting corresponds to the selection in the Printers check box on the Local Resources tab under Options in RDC.

options.name: remove_non_updatable_params
options.description: When given yes, the module will remove any parameters that are not updatable in the resource. If no, the module will return error if any non-updatable parameters are provided.

options.name: save_config
options.description: If C(true) the module will save the configuration on the NetScaler ADC node if it makes any changes. The module will not save the configuration on the NetScaler ADC node if it made no changes.

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the resource being configured by the module on the NetScaler ADC node. When C(present), the resource will be added/updated configured according to the module's parameters. When C(absent), the resource will be deleted from the NetScaler ADC node. When C(unset), the resource will be unset on the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(false), SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.

options.name: videoplaybackmode
options.description: This setting determines if Remote Desktop Connection (RDC) will use RDP efficient multimedia streaming for video playback.
